_about: The subscribe-video ads, Oct 25 2026 on: two per town. Video 1 is Halloween week (runs Oct 25-31); video 2 is evergreen, built on what readers said they want (live music first), with no dates, so it can run for weeks. Each entry: what to say (in Tristen's own style: what you're missing, a few real examples, one free email every Monday and Thursday, click the link), the hook for the corner badge, the event cards (icon, tag, title, venue; cue = the spoken word that pops each one; text = the one-line fallback), the ad's primary text (caption) and headline, and its run window in town time (run_until_local null = until stopped). Every script ends on the newsletter's name: the end card starts at the last time the name or address is said.
